# BucketBridge

> Free, open-source (GPL-3.0) S3 client for Windows, macOS and Linux: a Tauri desktop app with a React UI and the `bb` command-line tool, both on one Rust core. Works with Amazon S3 and S3-compatible storage (custom endpoints, path-style addressing; tested against MinIO). No account, no telemetry; secrets stay in the OS keychain.

## Features

- Upload, download, copy, move, rename and delete files and folders; drag and drop; resumable multipart transfers with checksums, pause, resume and a bandwidth cap
- Folder sync (up, down, both ways, bucket to bucket) with a dry run, saved jobs and exclusion files
- Accounts from access keys, AWS profiles, IAM Identity Center (SSO), assumed roles with MFA, and instance roles
- Bucket settings: policy, public access block, versioning, CORS, lifecycle, replication, object lock, website hosting; IAM users and CloudFront
- Previews (images, text, JSON, XML, CSV and Parquet tables), edit in place, presigned links, bucket usage, security scan, listing export
- `bb` CLI with NDJSON output (`--json`), `--dry-run` and stable exit codes
- English and Simplified Chinese
